nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: The query matcher is case-folded substring + IDF only - no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language matching - so the question is expanded against the graph's actual label vocabulary (max 12 tokens, never invented) to prevent 0-hit collapse while keeping the expansion auditable.

nodes.label: BFS/DFS Graph Traversal
nodes.rationale: BFS (depth 3) for broad 'what is X connected to' context; DFS (depth 6) for tracing a specific dependency chain; output is token-budget ranked and truncated. Answer only from what the graph contains - never hallucinate edges.

nodes.label: Save-Result Work-Memory Loop
nodes.rationale: Every answered query is saved back into the graph with an outcome tag (useful/dead_end/corrected) so the next --update extracts the Q&A as a node; graphify reflect compiles LESSONS.md listing preferred sources, known dead ends, and corrections - a self-improving loop across sessions.
